messages.author: a8b6459b77c849fe
messages.subject: RStan destabilizes R?
parts:
For the last couple of years, on both Windows and Mac, I have found that RStan tends to destabilize R. That is, when I'm using RStan a lot, R itself starts crashing a lot. In the last two days, as I have been experimenting with some Stan models, R has crashed on me three times. The most recent crashes seem to occur at random moments -- in the middle of typing a command, when reloading the package I'm developing, etc.

Does anyone else have any experience with this, and any suggestions for dealing with the problem?

messages.subject: Re: RStan destabilizes R?
parts: Totally wild guess from someone who uses RStudio: if you stop Stan in the middle of sampling with the "Stop" button the chains are still going in the background. I get around this by manually killing those processes from the terminal.

messages.author: a2bfdf24157fa01a
messages.subject: Re: RStan destabilizes R?
parts:
Rstudio in general is not always stable. I moved from Rstudio to Emacs, and have not had a single R session crash in many years. This quarter, I decided to use Rstudio for teaching R, as it is easier to use for most people new to R. After crashing R multiple times during a lecture, I am back to using Emacs.

I would guess this is an Rstudio issue, not a Stan issue.

Matt
